{{Quote|The cuisine of the Kubaz may not be for everyone, but I guarantee you'll want to finish your meal with a thick slice of this scrumptious royal jelly roll.|Dex's description of the roll on his diner's menu|<ref name="DaD" />}}
'''Kubindian royal jelly rolls''' were a dessert made by the [[Kubaz/Legends|Kubaz]] [[Species/Legends|species]] that contained a filling made from a blend of various [[Insect/Legends|insects]]&mdash;worker [[zingbee]]s, [[arthropinian]]s, and [[Pectin-fly|pectin-flies]]. The entire dish was also dusted with the powdered [[Chitin/Legends|chitin]] of [[sun beetle]]s. The [[Restaurant/Legends|eatery]] known as [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] served the dessert in slices for 2.7 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] each, and the establishments owner, the [[Besalisk/Legends|Besalisk]] [[Chef/Legends|chef]] [[Dexter Jettster/Legends|Dexter Jettster]], listed it under the "favorite desserts" section of the menu, describing it as scrumptious. The dish was served at Dex's<ref name="DaD" /> at some point no earlier than [[28 BBY/Legends|28 BBY]].<ref name="DexDates">{{Hyperspace|url=fans/hyperspace/source/dexdiner/index.html|text=Dining at Dex's|int=Dining at Dex's}} is set at some point no earlier than [[28 BBY/Legends|28 BBY]] per the {{DiningAtDexDate}}.</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Kubindian royal jelly rolls were first mentioned in the [[2009]] [[StarWars.com]] [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]] exclusive article, "[[Dining at Dex's]]," which was written by [[Gregory Walker]] in the style of an [[in-universe]] menu.<ref name="DaD" />
